admission.justification: Grant authority, start-boundary retention, pre-code judgment and same-generation pair recovery are needed together; any one alone can allow unauthorized or incomplete direct publication.

guarantee: A direct leaf starts shared master-checkout work only under its external pre-start grant without another active granted non-Completed sibling, and starts publication under exact-pair gates. Grant mutation/reclamation retain started authority; an accepted irreversible code output completes its same-generation memory pair without a second code commit.
title: Granted leaf publication and recovery
